title: 24 Saint James Crescent, Mervue, Galway City, H91THT4
seoTitle: 24 Saint James Crescent, Mervue, Galway City, H91THT4
description:
O'Donnellan & Joyce present a delightful two bed mid terrace property situated at Saint James Crescent, Mervue, Galway. 

Mervue is a popular and well-established location on the East side of Galway City.  

The area offers plenty of communal green areas, with nearby sporting and recreational facilities such as Merlin Park Woods, Liam Mellows GAA Grounds, Galwegians Rugby Club. 

Located in the heart of Mervue, 24 Saint James Crescent is superbly positioned within walking distance of Mervue Church, Radharc Na Mara National School and the nearby Ballybane Shopping Centre

Presented in good condition measuring circa 85 sqm over two storeys, the accommodation comprises of an entrance hall, sitting room, open plan dining & family room, and a rear kitchen.

Upstairs the property offers a main bathroom that is accessible from the landing and the main front bedroom a second double room completes the first floor.

Externally the front garden offers a paved driveway with ample off-street parking and mature planting.  

A huge bonus to this property is the rear garden space which is also accessible via a pedestrian gate from the lane/road to the rear of dwelling.  Parking to the rear could be a possibility if garden was reconfigured to allow the required access.

A raised decking & patio, large shed/workroom and paved pathway leading to a pedestrian gate onto rear lane access completes the rear garden.

ATU College Campus and several excellent National & Secondary Schools are all within walking distance.  A regular bus route to and from Galway City services the area daily.  

The locale is also close to Briarhill Shopping Centre and several business and retails parks such as Parkmore, Ballybrit, & Mervue Industrial Park.  Nearby cafes and hotels provide all other necessary amenities.

Major employers in the area include various hospitals & medical device companies such as Bon Secour, The Galway Clinic, Merlin Park Hospital, Boston Scientific, Merit Medical and Creganna.

Several outdoor amenities located nearby include the popular Ballyloughane Beach, Renmore parklands, Lough Atalia & lakeshore playgrounds, Renmore Scouts Den, and Galway City Sailing Club. 

The area is excellently serviced by quality transport links allowing easy access to Galway City Centre, neighbouring suburbs, as well as the M6 & M18 motorways. 

No 24 Saint James Crescent is an ideal property for a variety of purchasers, and the ideal location for those wishing to live close to Galway city while having the benefits of living in the suburbs. 

Viewing is highly recommended and guaranteed not to disappoint.
